principles: Separate public process semantics by field name instead of relying on explanations.
Keep compatibility for existing story_review consumers while steering new consumers to explicit names.
Back every process-fact naming rule with source-level test or contract coverage.
drivers: Avoid confusion between PLAN review count and signed artifact ISO reviewRound.
Minimize blast radius in a local CLI used across projects.
Keep docs aligned with runtime output.

options.name: A: Add explicit numeric aliases and keep legacy reviewRound temporarily
cons: Old ambiguous field remains visible until a later breaking cleanup

options.name: B: Rename reviewRound outright and remove the old field
cons: Could break unknown scripts or agents parsing story_review.reviewRound

chosen: A: Add explicit numeric aliases and keep legacy reviewRound temporarily
rationale: Choose the compatibility path because story_review is a public CLI response and this story is about removing semantic confusion without surprising existing local automation. The hard signal becomes the new explicit field plus contract/smoke documentation.

preMortem.scenario: Consumers still read legacy reviewRound and remain confused
preMortem.trigger: Docs only mention the alias without warning
preMortem.mitigation: Document legacyReviewRound compatibility and assert explicit numeric fields in tests.
